ops.body: - Tap to capture a place (decision 0223; audit 2026-11-13): a place can be armed only from the walk screen's card (not the Explore tab's cards or a pin's viewer); passing does not weigh fix accuracy, so a 4 m setting is as sharp as the phone's GPS; arming is the screen's state, so a reload clears it; imperial steps of 2 m read as uneven feet; `findFor` and `findCandidates` remain for tests only

argv: superseded by decision 0223: a moment is never tagged by nearness, only by Capture here (the owner, Nov 12); spec E8 amended there
Explore in a dense city (DC1-DC19, decision 0156)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, start an exploring walk, tap a place's "?" or name, tap Capture here, then take a photo (or a memo or note). **Expect:** the card closes and a plain line says "The next moment is about <place>" with Cancel; the photo then shows "Found: <place>" once and the line goes; a photo taken near a place without arming finds nothing. (TC3, TC4, tap-to-capture-places)

argv: Explore in a dense city (DC1-DC19, decision 0156)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, set Passing a place to 4 m in the walk's options, walk past a marked place at about 10 m and then at about 3 m. **Expect:** the first passes nothing; the second shows "Passed <place> without stopping" in the replay, never a count. (TC6, TC7, TC9, tap-to-capture-places)
